what: The tables this package carries in source because no artifact exists to fetch, pinned by digest the way a fetched image is.
why: These are data lifted from the hardware rather than a design anyone here chose, and no manufacturer published them as a file. Nothing was checking that they stay what they were: the decoder walks them on every stream, and an edit that preserved the invariants would change every output with nothing to notice.
howTheDigestIsTaken: sha256 of the values as compact JSON, json.dumps(list(table), separators=(',', ':')) encoded as UTF-8. Of the values rather than of the source, so reformatting the module, rewrapping a line or changing a comment leaves the digest alone and changing a number does not.
whatThisIsNot: A claim that the table is correct. The self-checks beside each one and this digest are different questions: the checks say the table could be the part's, the digest says it has not changed since somebody last argued that it is.
notStated: No Ricoh or Nintendo document for this part has been found, so no entry here can carry a publisher's digest and none pretends to.

tables.name: EVOLUTION
tables.what: The state machine every context walks: the code size to use, and where to go when each symbol arrives.

tables.name: RUN_TABLE
tables.what: What a code word turns into as a run length.

tables.name: CONTEXT_MASKS
tables.what: Which bits of a plane's recent history select its context, one row per shape the header byte picks.
tables.selfCheck: Read beside the header byte that selects the row.
